appended.method: churn passes must re-verify quota-per-day denominators, not just model counts; model-count-only churn lets the free-budget denominator go stale until the lane 429s
track escalate-rate drift + blinded frontier spot-checks of accepted verdicts to catch silent cascade inversion (confidence decoupled from accuracy); the judge must never move its own gate
prompt uplift must carry FACTS/bibliography byte-verbatim or FAIL(BIB_LAUNDER); evidence-quote obligation sits on the judge seat when the judge is score-only
amendments carry scenario cards built from real failing traces and pass both runtimes before merge; a human gate without a regression criterion is a signature, not a gate
grow the rejection taxonomy only via detector-miss induction (probe classes the monitors demonstrably missed); a lane self-certifying its own success is void without an external check
queues become machine-readable indexes with seat-tag retrieval keys before embedding; defer embeddings until item count or retrieval miss-rate crosses a measured threshold
consensus requires heterogeneous primary witnesses; a single-vendor announcement chain re-sold across outlets is one voice regardless of source count (vendor-echo laundering detector)
seasonal calendars get a fresh platform-announcement verification pass before each milestone date executes; citation-time pointer-rot fix (301s) noted at read time
coverage percentages must state their denominator (frozen corpus vs live source); when the live source advances past the frozen corpus, harvest deltas instead of re-celebrating 100 percent

drift pairs ride white-box local lanes only; steering packs are attack surface and get verified before they steer; register confidence/entropy vs verdict-correctness pairs per local lane with pre-registered kill verdicts

zero-result sets from search wrappers get a control-phrase test before being trusted (false-negative retrieval masks corpus-wide absences); owed items get multi-route chases (direct, archive OCR, API JSON, scholarly substitutes) before they stay owed

playtest gates name the scored currency of the existing pattern (net VM) and instrument new mechanics as log lines with full state (VOW-TAKEN seat/t/vow/price/spent/seed-mode); seed audits byte-compare same-seed sequences at the raw distribution, no pity systems
sharing is gated: canon drops priced by a pre-registered falsifier, caches/keys/drafts never shared; a capability in one seat only is a vault by definition (second-seat sharing test)

concurrent-claim law: shared-file writes need single-writer locks (interleaved-write census corruption + receipt-before-disk divergence are live species); falsifier: >2 self-feed renumber corrections in next 50 B2 rows forces the lock build
closure receipts get re-checked against the FULL original finding text: a falsifier scoped narrower than the charge at prereg time clears only what it tests

envelope probes retune max_concurrency IN PLACE on one running body of work (2->4->8->16 ladder), never fresh runs per rung: nothing re-paid, zero deaths, and the admission ceiling reads straight off the health line

5.3-max judgment work admits ~7 concurrent streams in a decayed window (width 2: 1-2 admitted, width 8: 7/8, width 14: 7/14 absorbed); width above admission buys queue depth not throughput; the instrument is concurrency=N/M + rate_limited on the health line, surfaced deaths no longer exist (unlimited retry absorbs them, B2-98 era instrument is blind here)

before building any instrument, grep the tree for an existing one AND check the scheduled task actually fired (elder audit LIVE 4 / DECLARED 33); a seat proposed the secret gate 3x before checking; wiring an unwired instrument beats writing a new one
